card.name: Words just before a dose or condition
card.fires_on: Words in drug-label text that sit right before a dose, patient group or condition detail, such as 'active' before psoriatic arthritis, 'mg' after a number, or 'older' after an age. It also fires on a digit inside a dose number.

modes.label: Dose numbers and units
modes.description: The digit or unit within a stated dose, such as the last digit of a number or mg after it.

modes.label: Qualifier before a condition
modes.description: An adjective or age word that narrows a patient group or disease, like active or psychiatric.

modes.label: Inside drug-name phrases
modes.description: A piece of a drug description or the bracket right after it, before a dose.
